reasons: Rule LD is correctly triggered: Section 4.2(a) requires the Company (our client, the customer) to pay HDI a termination payment computed as 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000 — a customer-payable liquidated amount, so 'deviation' is the right status.

The redline implements the playbook fallback faithfully: a single early-termination fee capped at three months' Section 3.1 fees, made sole and exclusive, limited to termination for convenience, and expressly excluded where the Company terminates under Section 1.6 or for HDI's breach.

The failed 'minimal edit' check is explained by the rule itself — the offending formula cannot be fixed in place and must be replaced; the edit stays within p0026 and leaves the rest of Section 4.2 intact.

Comment is accurate, correctly characterizes the existing formula as uncapped and unrelated to the 30%-of-Net-Sales revenue share, cites the playbook position and the reason for accepting the fallback, and follows the required prefix and tone.

Minor, non-blocking: p0029's eight-quarterly-instalment mechanic is left unamended (harmless, and if anything favourable to us), and the Section 1.6 cross-reference should be confirmed against the executed text.
